surface: A 200-row grid in a 120 px viewport: PageDown and Ctrl+Arrow move the focus past the rows on screen, to rows the grid renders only then, and each cell keeps its row position.

steps.note: PageDown moves the selection one viewport down, past the rows a user saw: the cell it lands on and its row position. Finding: VoiceOver says nothing on the first PageDown, on both browsers (both recordings); NVDA names the cell.

A second PageDown, into rows the grid rendered only after the first one scrolled. Finding (VoiceOver's): VoiceOver names no row number on a focus move, on either browser: WebKit reads the header and the value (`alpha a7`), Chromium adds the row's cells (`row a7 b7 c7`). The row group misses on all four VoiceOver key steps that have one (here, to-last-row, arrow-up and to-first-row), as grid-core records for a well-formed ARIA grid too.

Ctrl+ArrowDown (Cmd on macOS) jumps to the last of the 200 rows, which the grid renders only once it scrolls there: its value and its position, which keeps counting past the rows on screen (row 201 counts the header row). Finding: with Chromium, NVDA and VoiceOver say nothing here (both recordings), where NVDA with Firefox and VoiceOver with WebKit name A 200. Finding (VoiceOver's): no row number, as on page-down-again.
Finding (VoiceOver's): no row number, as on page-down-again.
Ctrl+ArrowUp (Cmd on macOS) jumps back to the first row. Finding (VoiceOver's): no row number, as on page-down-again.
